children: New Delhi, Oct. 17 -- Axis Bank has appointed Rahul Shukla, a former HDFC Bank veteran, to head its Commercial and Bharat Banking business.
The appointment brings an experienced banking professional into a key role at Axis Bank, which serves businesses and customers across multiple segments of the Indian banking market.
